name: Hotel Ivy, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Minneapolis
insider_take: Historic glamour meets modern luxury in the heart of Minneapolis' cultural district, where jazz legends once performed and literary giants found inspiration.
whats_special: This boutique gem occupies a beautifully restored 1930s building that originally housed the famous Lyceum Theater. The hotel's Porter & Frye restaurant pays homage to the neighborhood's rich jazz heritage, while each room features custom furnishings and original artwork. You're steps from the iconic Guthrie Theater and Mill City Museum, built within the ruins of what was once the world's largest flour mill.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on the upper floors for stunning views of the Mississippi River and downtown skyline – especially magical during Minneapolis' famous autumn foliage season.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature afternoon tea service in the elegant lobby, and a evening stroll along the nearby Stone Arch Bridge – a National Historic Landmark offering panoramic views of Saint Anthony Falls, the only major waterfall on the Mississippi River.
pros: Prime downtown Minneapolis location near theaters and attractions
Sophisticated boutique design with contemporary luxury amenities
Exceptional dining at Porter & Frye restaurant
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects upscale positioning
Urban setting with limited parking availability
